pages.text: To perform the Demesnes ritual, you will need to construct a Demesne Beacon and place it on top of a pyramid, just like a vanilla beacon.

The size of the pyramid determines the extent of your Claim: a platform of 3x3 blocks will claim a 1x1 area, all the way up to a pyramid with a 9x9 base letting you claim 7x7 chunks. You can preview the Claimed area in your Sight. Right-click the beacon to see what spirit type you will gain affinity for if you succeed.

Once you're ready, click the Claim button to begin the ritual. To succeed, you will have to defeat three waves of challengers who dispute your Claim to the space. They will spawn around the border and be highlighted in your Sight. Leaving the bounds or dying will end the ritual and dismiss the challengers, and you will have to try again.

The difficulty of the ritual scales exponentially with the size of your Claim. A 1x1 Claim might attract a few zombies per wave, a 3x3 Claim is similar to a Raid, and anything higher will likely require preparation of the area. Be forewarned that ghasts or creepers might show up, but remember that protection shrines can prevent mob griefing.

The type of challengers that show up will vary depending on factors such as dimension, installed mods, and time of day. They will try to spawn near your Y-level and adapt to the local terrain (water will attract water mobs, empty air will attract flying mobs). Later waves might attract challengers from other dimensions.
